excerpts.text: Serving Passaic & Bergen Counties including Wayne, Passaic, Clifton, and nearby Cities

Visiting Angels of Wayne provides **professional home care** to seniors in order to help them live out their golden years in familiar and comfortable surroundings while remaining safe and content. We are proud to be locally owned and provide professional, quality in-home senior care that families have relied on since 2003. We cater to families in the Ridgewood area and throughout Passaic and Bergen Counties, including Wayne, Teaneck, Passaic, Clifton, Ridgewood, Nutley, Little Falls, and nearby communities in New Jersey. We focus on providing flexible [in-home care services](https://www.visitingangels.com/passaic/what-is-home-care) that fits into the lifestyles of each and every client, which sets us apart from other local caregiving agencies.

As you look for professional care, you believe that nursing homes and assisted living facilities are your only options. At Visiting Angels of Wayne, we provide another option: home care. With the assistance of an Angel companion, your loved one can enjoy the comforts of home while receiving the professional care they need.

Why do so many families in Passaic and Bergen Counties choose Visiting Angels of Wayne for their in-home senior care needs? As an agency that has served the community for over two decades, we have curated our team of caregivers from the best of the best in the home care industry in Passaic and Bergen Counties.
